name: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore
short_description: A 32-storey Ritz-Carlton on Raffles Avenue in Marina Centre, overlooking Marina Bay.
ai_summary: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore is a 32-storey tower on Raffles Avenue in Marina Centre, within walking distance of Marina Bay Sands, the Esplanade, and the Suntec convention district. Ranked among the top 100 of nearly 380 Singapore hotels on TripAdvisor, it draws strong, specific praise for staff who remember guests by name, refurbished rooms with large beds and Marina Bay views, and housekeeping so thorough some guests describe it as twice-daily with turndown chocolates. As Bonvoy's top luxury tier, it's positioned for both business travelers using the nearby convention facilities and leisure travelers wanting a Marina Bay address. The clearest recurring complaint is breakfast: reviews describe wait times and a serving area that can feel undersized relative to demand, alongside occasional mentions of dated decor in older wings and premium dining prices.

faqs.question: Is breakfast a strong point at The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore?
faqs.answer: It's a mixed picture -- while the hotel scores well overall, breakfast is the most frequently repeated complaint in guest reviews, with wait times reported during busy periods and a serving area some guests describe as undersized for demand.

faqs.question: How close is The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore to Marina Bay Sands?
faqs.answer: It's within easy walking distance -- the hotel sits on Raffles Avenue in Marina Centre, close to Marina Bay Sands, the Esplanade, and the Suntec convention district.

reviews.title: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore Review: Still the City's Best?
reviews.author: Celest Tan
reviews.summary: An older Kevin Roche-designed property that stays relevant through mature, human-centered service. Praises spacious rooms, the octagonal bathroom window, local dishes and the five-presentation Club Lounge; dings weak shower pressure.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore (Club Premier Suite)
reviews.author: Shawn Loh
reviews.summary: Detailed stay in the 72sqm Club Premier Suite with panoramic Marina Bay and Singapore Flyer views. Highlights the iconic octagonal bathroom window, benchmark Colony breakfast and one of Singapore's most luxurious club lounges.

reviews.title: Review: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore - Worth it?
reviews.author: Louise
reviews.summary: Booked via Amex Fine Hotels + Resorts and upgraded to a Deluxe Marina Room. Loves the stunning Marina views, gorgeous interiors and exceptional breakfast, but finds service less warm and personalized than peers of similar caliber.

reviews.title: Review: The Ritz-Carlton Millenia Hotel - Club Premier Suite (Singapore)
reviews.author: Dania
reviews.summary: Level-29 corner Club Premier Suite with Marina Bay and Singapore Flyer views. Rates it 5/5, praising the five-presentation club lounge, attentive smiling staff, and thoughtful touches like a birthday cake and limousine drop-off.

reviews.title: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore Club room review: The joy of rediscovering the little things in life
reviews.author: Charmaine Tai
reviews.summary: Club-room stay focused on the Club Lounge (open 6:30am-11:30pm) with Marina Bay window seats, the 25m pool, and marble bathrooms offering one of the best tub views in Singapore.
